text:
marco_sales: Heads-up: VeloxSystems wants to run a POC next week. Their security team tightened identity asks (SSO + SCIM + strict RBAC). Need quick preflight.


sylvie_se: I can do a fast preflight. Key asks?


marco_sales: They require SAML IdP & SP-initiated flows, SCIM v2 with delta support, delegated admin for tenant ops, and domain-locked provisioning. CISO needs answers by Thu.


anya_pm: Note: POC on dedicated nodes. We need to confirm token/day credits and whether domain locking can be enforced.


lucy_billing: We can offer up to 150k tokens/day in credits for a 2-week POC. Anything > that needs a short paid uplift. I can draft a one-page trial SOW.


syIvie_se: SCIM specifics: we support /Users and /Groups endpoints, delta via ChangeLog. Rate limit for enterprise POC: 1k ops/min. For >20k users recommend bulk import (we run a job). Delegated admin: supported via admin-scoped tokens.


marco_sales: Velox uses transient NameID; they want email as subjectNameID. Can our SSO UI map that?


syIvie_se: Yes, SSO mapping supports attribute transforms. I'll send step-by-step. If they need group->role mapping, we only have admin-API mapping today; workaround is a small sync lambda.


syIvie_se: Example POC snippet:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"group":"velox-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'



tariq_sec: Security Qs: they asked about BYOK and audit retention. We support AWS/GCP/Azure KMS BYOK, keys non-exportable. Default audit retention 90d; enterprise can opt to 180/365d. For HSM/FIPS we can provide attestation on request.


verify_bot: domain_check: veloxsystems.com TXT token pending. ticket#6721.


anya_pm: Actions: Sylvie -> SSO mapping doc + SCIM runbook; Lucy -> SOW/credits; Tariq -> security Q answers. I'll schedule 30m preflight with Velox tomorrow 9:30am PT.


marco_sales: Thanks team, I'll ping Velox to add TXT for domain verification and confirm expected user count.
